params.message: The stainless-steel surface is cold and scarred. A Bunsen burner sits at the ready, and a coil of rubber tubing runs to a gas tap. Equations are carved into the leg.
You put on the noise-cancelling headphones. The ambient hum of the lab fades into silence.
You take off the headphones. The lab's quiet hum returns.
You strap the blackout goggles over your eyes. The world goes completely dark.
You pull off the blackout goggles. Light floods back in.
You fasten the ball gag. Your jaw is forced open and your tongue is pinned. No sound can get out.
You unbuckle the ball gag. Your jaw is free again.
The stainless-steel surface is cold and scarred. A Bunsen burner sits at the ready, and a coil of rubber tubing runs to a gas tap. Equations are carved into the leg.
You strap the blackout goggles over your eyes. The world goes completely dark.
You pull off the blackout goggles. Light floods back in.
You rinse your eyes with the cool liquid. Blinking, the world swims back into sharp focus.

params.success_message: the liquid burns going down, but warmth spreads through your body. your aches fade. whatever this is, it works.

params.message: The sharp scent jolts through your sinuses - you're wide awake now.
The bitter draught burns through you. The stiffness in your muscles melts away and you can move again.
The dust grits into your eyes and everything goes black. You blink furiously.
A burning cold races through your veins. The room fades to black.
A cold stiffness races through your body. You freeze mid-motion, muscles locked tight.

entries.message: Dawn breaks clear over the valley; mist lifts off the river.
Clouds roll in from the northern hills, softening the midday sun.
A steady rain settles in as evening draws on, beading on the leaves.
